note: Selects BUFFER for BODY and restores the previously current buffer after it -- deliberately not point in it, which is Emacs' scope for this form too. Since Phase 11 (11D Part 4) it is a prelude `unwind-protect' macro over the shared internal--excursion-capture / internal--excursion-restore natives, not the internal--with-current-buffer native that re-entered the evaluator with BODY as a lambda.
